2607.17219.title: Auditing Question-Order Effects in Large Language Models with the QQ Equality: Mechanism Characterization and a Saturation Caveat
2607.17219.paper_summary: Human survey respondents exhibit question-order effects that satisfy the QQ (quantum question) equality, an a priori, parameter-free prediction of the projective quantum question-order model. We develop the QQ equality into an audit criterion for sequential judgments of autoregressive large language models (LLMs). Theoretically, we characterize which mechanism classes satisfy it robustly: marginal-independent kernels satisfy QQ iff all four mismatch transition rates coincide (a class containing the 2D rank-1 projective model with a fixed measurement pair under state variation); a polarity- and position-dependent repetition family is characterized by an exact cross-symmetry condition with closed-form violations; QQ-satisfying behaviors are closed under order-matched mixing; and the rank-2 Contextuality-by-Default criterion translates into audit coordinates as $|\qQQ|\le\OSS$, where $\OSS$ (the order-sensitivity score) totals the order sensitivity of the two marginals. Methodologically, we develop a pre-specified, audit-logged pipeline applicable to any model exposing next-token log-probabilities; it combines worst-case robustness envelopes, sampling-consistency spot checks, full label counterbalancing, and a saturation diagnostic. Empirically, in a first-signal pilot on an open-weight instruction-tuned model under two framings, all pre-specified health gates passed, yet 17/18 and 7/8 item pairs, respectively, were saturated (near-deterministic), and no item was certified residually contextual. Forced-binary next-token log-probabilities were thus inadequate for distribution-level QQ audits under the tested model and prompting conditions; we recommend pre-specified saturation diagnostics whenever next-token distributions are treated as survey-response distributions.
2607.17219.paper_summary_zh: 人類調查受訪者顯示出滿足 QQ（量子問題）平等的問題順序效應，這是投影量子問題順序模型的一個先驗、無參數預測。我們將 QQ 平等發展為自回歸大型語言模型（LLMs）序列判斷的審核標準。在理論上，我們描述了哪些機制類別能夠穩健地滿足它：邊際獨立核當且僅當所有四個不匹配轉換率一致時滿足 QQ（這是一個包含在狀態變化下具有固定測量對的 2D 等級-1 投影模型的類別）；一個依賴極性和位置的重複家族由精確的交叉對稱條件及其封閉形式的違反特徵化；滿足 QQ 的行為在順序匹配混合下是封閉的；而等級-2 默認情境性標準轉換為審核坐標為 $|\qQQ|\le\OSS$，其中 $\OSS$（順序敏感性分數）總結了兩個邊際的順序敏感性。在方法論上，我們開發了一個預先指定的、審核記錄的管道，適用於任何暴露下一個標記對數概率的模型；它結合了最壞情況的穩健性包絡、抽樣一致性現場檢查、完整標籤平衡和飽和診斷。在實證上，在兩種框架下對一個開放權重的指令調整模型進行的首次信號試點中，所有預先指定的健康門檻均通過，但 17/18 和 7/8 的項目對分別達到飽和（近確定性），且沒有項目被認證為剩餘情境性。因此，在測試模型和提示條件下，強制二元下一個標記對數概率對於分佈級 QQ 審核是不足的；我們建議在將下一個標記分佈視為調查回應分佈時，預先指定飽和診斷。
2607.17219.author: Pilsung Kang et.al.
